faa_pan26.source: FAA William J. Hughes Technical Center, GPS SPS Performance Analysis Report #26 (30 July 1999), paper/PAN26_0499.pdf
faa_pan26.method: Weekly almanac; every 5 deg grid point 180W-180E (72 longitudes) x 80S-80N (33 latitudes) = 2376 points; PDOP every minute for 24 h (1440 samples); 5 deg mask, no obscura; good = 4+ satellites and PDOP <= 6. Spec: global average >= 99.9 %, worst-case point >= 96.9 %.
